title: Playboy Lot of 4 Chyna Joanie Laurer Gena Lee Nolin Jaime Pressly 2001 2007
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 original Playboy magazines featuring several notable celebrity and model issues.

Included:

* November 2001 — Angelica Bridges cover/pictorial; Coen Brothers interview
* December 2001 — Gena Lee Nolin cover/pictorial; Will Smith interview
* January 2002 Holiday Anniversary Issue — Joanie Laurer (Chyna) cover/pictorial; Gene Simmons and Dan Patrick features
* September 2007 — Christa Campbell cover/pictorial; Jaime Pressly and Clive Owen features

All four are original newsstand copies with barcodes.

Pre-owned vintage condition. There is visible handling, edge/corner and surface wear consistent with age. The September 2007 issue shows somewhat more edge/corner wear than the others. Please review the photos closely for exact condition.

You will receive the exact four magazines pictured.
